headline_en: 0 after audit · Oct Fed gap 11.5pp (Altınla) vs 4.6pp (Investing)
headline_zh: 审计后 0 条 · 十月美联储缺口 11.5pp（Altınla）对 4.6pp（Investing）
sub_en: 730 markets scanned. 1 raw “edge.” 0 survived fees and a full exclusive set. Book depth unverified. Economic mismatch flag on the primary source: PM +25bp mid 0.195 vs Altınla CME hike-bin 0.31 (gap 11.5pp). Secondary Investing hike-bin 0.241 (gap 4.6pp) — the two CME-method sources disagree by 6.9pp. Not an arbitrage.
sub_zh: 扫描 730 个市场。原始“优势” 1 条。扣费且互斥组完整后 0 条。盘口深度未核验。主源出现经济错配标记：PM +25bp mid 0.195 对 Altınla CME 加息档 0.31（缺口 11.5pp）。次源 Investing 加息档 0.241（缺口 4.6pp）——两个 CME 方法来源彼此差 6.9pp。不是套利。

fee.note_en: Use each market’s feeSchedule.rate when feesEnabled. Never assume 0.
fee.note_zh: feesEnabled 时用该市场 feeSchedule.rate，不默认 0。

fed.cme_source: Altınla FedWatch PRIMARY (bins_sane) / ZQV26 96.1175 · Oct28 hold(3.75–4.00)=0.69 hike(4.00–4.25)=0.31 · asof Updated: October 6, 2026 at 06:23 AM UTC · Yahoo ZQV26.CBT 96.118 confirms · Investing secondary hike=0.241 hold=0.759 (Oct 06, 2026 04:25AM EDT)
fed.note_en: October watch. PM exclusive +25bp mid 0.195 vs Altınla CME-method hike-bin 0.31 (gap 11.5pp) — mismatch_flag true (≥~8–10pp). Investing secondary hike=0.241 (gap 4.6pp, below threshold), so the flag rests on one source. Buying the whole NegRisk set costs 1.0362 after 5% fees — no edge. Contracts are not identical (CME 4.00–4.25 bin ≈ PM exclusive +25bp only from current 3.75–4.00). Paper inconsistency mark, not a trade.
fed.note_zh: 十月观察。PM 独家 +25bp mid 0.195 对 Altınla CME 方法加息档 0.31（缺口 11.5 个百分点）——错配标记 true（≥约 8–10pp）。Investing 次源加息档 0.241（缺口 4.6pp，未过阈值），所以这个标记只靠一个来源。整组 NegRisk 扣 5% 费后成本 1.0362，无边。合约不完全相同（CME 4.00–4.25 档仅在当前 3.75–4.00 时约等于 PM 独家 +25bp）。只是纸面不一致标记，不是交易。
fed.recheck_en: Re-check if: (1) contracts are definition-matched, AND (2) NegRisk net cost/share < 1 after live feeSchedule, AND (3) the expensive legs still have size, OR |PM−CME gap| ≥ ~8–10pp on matched bins.
fed.recheck_zh: 重检条件：定义对齐，且 NegRisk 扣现费后净成本 < 1，且贵的那几条仍有深度；或对齐档上 |PM−CME| 缺口 ≥ 约 8–10 个百分点。

receipt.reason_en: Scanner summed 38 live asks (gross 0.911, net 0.9373 after 4% fees). The event is NegRisk-augmented with 49 markets; 11 placeholders (Person Q–Z, Other) are inactive with no book. If ‘Other’ or a later-added name wins, every bought Yes pays 0, so the set is not exhaustive. Fillable size is also dust: C=5.1 shares (≈$0.32 paper ‘profit’).
receipt.reason_zh: 扫描加总了 38 条在线卖一（毛 0.911，扣 4% 费后净 0.9373）。该事件是 NegRisk 扩展型，共 49 个市场；11 个占位（Person Q–Z、Other）未激活、没有盘口。若“Other”或之后新增的人胜出，买入的所有 Yes 都归零，所以互斥组不穷尽。可成交深度也只是尘埃：C=5.1 股（纸面‘利润’约 $0.32）。
receipt.recheck_en: Re-check only if placeholders are retired/resolved (or tradeable with asks) so the set is exhaustive, AND sum(ask)+fees < 1 with size above dust.
receipt.recheck_zh: 只有占位被撤销/结算（或有可买卖一）使互斥组穷尽，且 sum(ask)+费 < 1、深度不是尘埃时才重检。

scan.near_miss_filter_en: Raw near-misses are Yes+No (or exclusive-set) net within a few cents of $1. Most are longshot dust. Watch list keeps incomplete partitions and the live Fed book.
scan.near_miss_filter_zh: 原始近失是 Yes+No（或互斥组）扣费后净成本离 $1 只差几分。多数是长尾尘埃。观察名单只留分区不完整、以及在轨的美联储盘。
scan.count_rule_en: 730 = 717 Yes/No books + 13 NegRisk events. Full set in universe.json.
scan.count_rule_zh: 730 = 717 个 Yes/No 盘 + 13 个 NegRisk 事件。全集在 universe.json。

method.en: Audit, not a teaser. Scan exclusive NegRisk Yes-asks; reject any incomplete partition; apply that market’s feeSchedule.rate (fee = C × rate × p × (1−p); rebate ignored). A Fed gap counts only if contracts are definition-matched. Scorecards freeze T−2h modal Yes mid vs BLS first print. Book / fill depth is unverified. Engine stays private; every number on this page is in desk.json.
method.zh: 这是审计，不是预告页。扫互斥 NegRisk 的 Yes 卖一；分区不完整就否；用该市场 feeSchedule.rate（fee = C × rate × p × (1−p)，忽略返佣）。利率缺口只在定义对齐时才算。记分卡用 T−2h 众数 Yes mid 对 BLS 首次。盘口/成交深度未核验。引擎不公开；这页每个数都在 desk.json。

history_policy.en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). 14–16 Sep snapshots are public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. Sep NFP public pre-print freeze is ship 2026-10-01-1051 (commit c416920); its print result is appended as 2026-10-05-nfp-print without rewriting freeze rows. Results are append-only.
history_policy.zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的事前公开冻结。9 月非农公开事前冻盘是船 2026-10-01-1051（commit c416920）；其公布结果以 2026-10-05-nfp-print 追加，冻盘行不改写。结果只追加。

notify.en: No push alerts. Poll desk.json. If verdict or scan.after_audit changes, the conclusion changed. GitHub commits are the publish log.
notify.zh: 没有推送。轮询 desk.json。verdict 或 scan.after_audit 变了就是结论变了。GitHub commit 是发布记录。
